docs.description: Choices: ["A", "B"] or [{value, label, description?, disabled?}].
Remote: the results of the current search, in the same shape. The server sets it (a signal patch through data-attr, or a morph).
The value; for multiple, a JSON array or values separated by commas. A new value from the server replaces it; the live value is the value property.
Visible label.
Placeholder text.
Pick several; they show as chips.
Type to filter the options (in the browser).
Type to search on the server: emits sb-search; the server answers with results.
Remote: debounce before sb-search, in ms.
Remote: characters needed before searching.
Show that results are on their way (bind it to data-indicator).
Show a button that clears the value.
Disable the control.
Name reported in sb-change (e.g. the field of a command) and submitted with its form.

Multiple: a text shown instead of chips, e.g. "{count} of {total} sources". {count} is the number picked, {more} those not shown as chips, {total} the options (or the total prop). With max-chips, it shows only beyond that many picks, after the chips.
Multiple: show at most this many chips on one line, then a "+K" chip (or the summary). 0 shows only the count; -1 (the default) shows every chip and wraps.
Summary: what {total} stands for, e.g. the number of results a remote search can reach. -1 (the default): the options it knows (remote: every option it has been offered).
Multiple: "Select all" (while a search filters: "Select the N matches") and "Clear" rows at the top of the list.
Actions: the text of "Select all".
Actions: the text of "Select the N matches" while a search filters the list. Text before a | is for one match.
Actions: the text of "Clear", also the clear button's accessible name.
Server-confirmed value: :state(pending) while the local value differs from the server's value attribute (see revert()).

events.name: sb-search
events.description: Remote: the query changed (debounced). detail: { query }. Answer by setting results.

events.name: sb-change
events.description: The value changed. detail: { name, value } (a string, or an array for multiple): ready for a command.
